verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a REST API and API keys for programmatic access to search and research report generation, plus an MCP server exposing the same functionality — evidence of building against official interfaces. However, there's no evidence of language-specific SDKs (Python/JS client libraries), only raw API/MCP endpoints, and no OpenAPI spec was found (probe returned 404s). Missing for 10: official SDK packages in specific languages, code samples/quickstarts, OpenAPI/API reference docs, independent developer corroboration of API/SDK use.
